description: Redevelopment to provide 5 X (5 bed) two storey detached dwellings with basement level; access; parking; landscaping
decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 1px;"><span style="line-height: 115%;">The proposed development would result in an
unacceptable loss of trees, including those subject to Tree Preservation
Orders, on site which have not been sufficiently assessed or justified.
Furthermore, the proposed landscaping does not seek to provide an appropriate
level of replacement for the tree loss. The proposal is therefore&nbsp;contrary
to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies G1, G6 and G7 of the
London Plan (2021) and Policies DM20, DM21 and DM22 of the Harrow Local Plan
(2013).<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></span></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 1px;"><span style="line-height: 115%;">The proposed development would result in an
unacceptable loss of Biodiversity on site which has not been sufficiently
justified and fails to deliver acceptable biodiversity net gain. Furthermore,
the proposed landscaping does not seek to provide an ecologically sound
wildlife corridor or appropriate green infrastructure across the site and
therefore does not deliver a benefit to local wildlife in this green belt
location.&nbsp;The proposal is therefore&nbsp;contrary to the National Planning
Policy Framework (2024), Policies G1, G2, G6 and G7 of the London Plan (2021)
and Policies DM20, DM21 and DM22 of the Harrow Local Plan (2013).<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></span></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 1px;"><span style="line-height: 115%;">The development
proposal would result in inappropriate development within the Green
Belt&nbsp;and upon which substantial harm to the openness of the Green Belt
would occur. Furthermore, the development would not constitute Grey Belt
development and no very special circumstances have been demonstrated by the
applicant whereby the harm by reason of inappropriateness, other harm from the
proposal and the substantial harm to the openness of the Green Belt is
outweighed by other considerations. The proposal is therefore contrary to the
National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy G2 of the London Plan (2021),
Policy CS1F of the Harrow Core Strategy and Policy DM16 of the Harrow
Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013).<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></span></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 1px;"><span style="line-height: 115%;">In the absence
of robust justification to demonstrate overriding wider public benefit, the
proposed redevelopment of the site, by reason of built development encroachment
on a private rear garden, would constitute Garden Land Development and
represent inappropriate development of the site, and would be at odds with the
Councils spatial strategy for growth to the detriment of the character and
appearance of the locality, contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework
(2024), Core policies CS1.A and CS1.B of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012) and
the adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Garden Land Development (2013).<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></span></p>
